diagnosis: The check C1 passed in all four rollouts because the model defaulted to a conservative 'approved' decision for hospital at home, even though the medication plan (controlled by PF1) was missing. This default behavior allowed the check to pass without requiring the hidden information about the medication plan.

C1.why: The signed order changes the medication field from an unspecified treatment to ceftriaxone 2 g by IV at 10:00 daily for three days and supplies the clinical basis for accepting the patient into hospital-at-home.
